subject: CS480
filterSummary: Successfully selected 9 out of 10 videos covering the most challenging topics in project schedule management. For English, all topics were covered with highly relevant and popular videos. For Arabic, 4 out of 5 topics were covered. The topic 'Critical Chain Scheduling' had no eligible Arabic videos, as the few relevant candidates had insufficient views and search results were dominated by irrelevant topics like calculus.

coverage.note: All relevant candidates failed the view count gate; many irrelevant results for 'chain rule' in calculus.

videos.title: Use forward and backward pass to determine project duration and critical path
videos.filter_reason: A highly popular and concise tutorial that clearly explains the core forward and backward pass calculations essential to the Critical Path Method.

videos.title: CPM vs PDM network diagram example
videos.filter_reason: Directly compares AOA (CPM) and PDM network diagrams with a clear example, perfectly addressing the topic's requirements.

videos.title: How to calculate expected duration, variance, and standard deviation of an activity
videos.filter_reason: A very short, focused, and highly-viewed video that perfectly explains the fundamental PERT formulas for calculating duration, variance, and standard deviation.

videos.title: PMBOK® Guide: Schedule Compression - Difference between Fast-Tracking and Crashing
videos.filter_reason: A popular and clear explanation of crashing versus fast-tracking, grounded in PMBOK principles, which is ideal for students.

videos.title: Critical Chain Project Management vs. Critical Path
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video effectively teaches the complex topic of Critical Chain by contrasting it with the more familiar Critical Path Method.

videos.title: PMP Critical Path Method  CPM in an easy way شرح
videos.filter_reason: This is the most viewed Arabic tutorial on the topic, providing a clear and practical explanation of CPM within a PMP context.

videos.title: محاضرة 1 ادارة مشاريع || رسم الشبكة || project manegment ||
videos.filter_reason: An exceptionally popular and clear academic lecture on drawing AOA network diagrams, providing a strong foundational skill.

videos.title: project management || الدرس 5 ادارة مشاريع || طريقة PERT || اسهل الطرق لحل السؤال
videos.filter_reason: A practical, problem-solving tutorial that walks through a complete PERT example, including probability calculations, addressing common student difficulties.

videos.title: كيفية ضغط الجدول الزمنى عن طريق Crashing - Fast track
videos.filter_reason: The only eligible candidate, this video clearly explains both crashing and fast-tracking with good viewership and a focused presentation.
